ai.title: AI provider
ai.subtitle: Powers the AI features: summary, classification, extraction, risk and Ask the mailbox. Choose None to turn them off.
ai.no_permission_body: You need settings write access to manage the AI plugin.
ai.field_base_url_hint: Optional. Empty: the provider's public API ({url}).
ai.field_api_key_set: A key is stored for this provider. Leave blank to keep it.
ai.field_api_key_hint: Encrypted at rest. Never sent to the browser after save.
ai.field_pii: Redact PII before calling the provider
ai.gdpr_note: Message text may be sent to your configured AI provider (redacted when PII redact is on). EmailBridge does not train models on your data. Enable ai.enabled per organisation or account.
ai.emb_hint: Semantic search and Ask the mailbox turn message text into vectors. Leave the base URL empty to reuse an OpenAI, Gemini or custom main provider; Anthropic and xAI need their own endpoint.
ai.emb_base_url_hint: For example https://api.openai.com/v1 or a local Ollama /v1 URL. Empty: the main provider.
ai.emb_model_hint: Required with an own base URL or a local provider. Changing it deletes the stored vectors.
ai.emb_api_key_hint: Optional. Without one the main API key is used when the main provider is reused.
ai.emb_problem_model: Set the embedding model to use semantic search.
ai.emb_problem_local: Set the base URL of the local provider, or an own embeddings base URL.
ai.emb_problem_key: Add an API key (main or embeddings) to use semantic search.
ai.field_base_url_hint_custom: Required: the OpenAI-compatible base URL, for example http://ollama.internal:11434/v1.
ai.field_api_key_hint_custom: Optional for local servers. Encrypted at rest, never shown again.
ai.none_hint: No provider: the AI features stay off. Stored keys are kept for when you pick a provider again.
ai.field_model_hint: Connect to load the models of the provider.
ai.field_model_manual_hint: The model ID exactly as the provider names it.
ai.emb_problem_no_api: This provider has no embeddings API: set an embeddings base URL and model to use semantic search.
ai.mcp_subtitle: Lets AI assistants and agents such as Claude, Cursor or VS Code use EmailBridge through the Model Context Protocol.
ai.mcp_no_permission_body: You need settings read access to see the MCP server.
ai.mcp_enabled_hint: The mcp.enabled switch. Off: every MCP request is refused.
ai.mcp_urls_hint: The main API always serves MCP; the dedicated port is optional.
ai.copy_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
ai.mcp_port_hint: For example 8090, or 127.0.0.1:8090 behind a reverse proxy on the same host. Empty: off. Applied without a restart.
ai.mcp_port_owner_only: Only the instance owner can change the port.
ai.mcp_port_bind_failed: The port could not be opened: {error}.
ai.mcp_port_security: The port serves only MCP with the same API-key checks as the main API, over plain HTTP: publish it through your reverse proxy with TLS and open it only to the hosts that need it.
ai.mcp_key_hint: Create an API key with the MCP scope (mcp:use) plus the scopes the assistant may use, for example messages:read. Paste it in place of the placeholder below.
ai.mcp_clients_hint: Pick your client and paste the configuration; replace the API key placeholder with your key.
ai.mcp_toolsets_hint: Every API operation is a tool, grouped in toolsets. Add ?toolsets=messages,sending to the URL to offer only some of them.
